claims.summary: In characteristic3 with N>=3 generic roots a0=0 and pair algebra A=K^r, the K-span of A^3 is all A. The retained cube-column image U=span_K(q_0,q_3,...,q_(3(ceil(r/3)-1))) is proper and contains1. Squared pair differences are pairwise distinct rational functions, so 1,delta,...,delta^(r-1) form a Vandermonde basis. No proper subspace containing1 is delta-invariant; neither delta nor its inverse induces multiplication on A/U. Correct row scaling instead changes the quotient to A/delta U. This excludes a decoupled Frobenius filtration, not full paired normality.
claims.assessment: Working all-dimensional proof passed by the sole fresh medium reviewer. Coordinate idempotents prove ambient Frobenius spans the target, and a generic pair-square Vandermonde proves cyclicity. Correct relative-scalar and actual-image quotient alternatives preserve the original unresolved map and endpoint u_a when r=3a. The N3 determinant is a symbolic nonvacuous control.
claims.rationale: A precise all-dimensional obstruction to a proposed source-preserving filtration, refining the existing warning about pair-algebra multipliers. The elementary Frobenius and Vandermonde facts are not claimed as independently novel; no normality range follows.
claims.next_action: Scheduled architecture review: select a rank mechanism for the actual coupled quotient or an alternative preserving the full generic paired prefix.
